metadata.question: Did the regions around Mount Isa and Townsville in Queensland experience over 65 centimeters of rainfall between January 27 to February 10, 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to analyze rainfall data for two locations in Queensland, Australia - Mount Isa: approximately (-20.73, 139.49) - Townsville: approximately (-19.26, 146.82) - Date range: January 27 to February 10, 2019 - Use GPM (Global Precipitation Measurement) data which provides precipitation in mm/hr - Need to accumulate precipitation over the entire period 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for precipitation data - Need to sum up all precipitation values over the time period - Convert from mm/hr to cm total 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: Regions with low/no rainfall would return 0 or small values (answer B) - Above 65 cm (650 mm): answer A - Check if collection is empty (C1) - Check if valid pixels exist (C2) - Check if result is None/NaN (C3) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define locations const mountIsa = ee.Geometry.Point([139.49, -20.73]); const townsville = ee.Geometry.Point([146.82, -19.26]); // Create regions around each point (10km buffer) const mountIsaRegion = mountIsa.buffer(10000); const townsvilleRegion = townsville.buffer(10000); // Date range const startDate = '2019-01-27'; const endDate = '2019-02-11'; // Inclusive of Feb 10 // Get GPM precipitation data const gpm = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_V06') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('precipitationCal'); const collectionSize = gpm.size().getInfo(); console.log('Collection size:', collectionSize); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('No precipitation data found for the date range.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Sum precipitation over the period (mm/hr * 0.5hr intervals) // GPM data is at 30-minute intervals const totalPrecip = gpm.sum().multiply(0.5); // Calculate for Mount Isa const mountIsaStats = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: mountIsaRegion, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const mountIsaCount = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: mountIsaRegion, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const mountIsaPrecip = mountIsaStats.get('precipitationCal').getInfo(); const mountIsaPixels = mountIsaCount.get('precipitationCal').getInfo(); // Calculate for Townsville const townsvilleStats = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: townsvilleRegion, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const townsvilleCount = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: townsvilleRegion, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const townsvillePrecip = townsvilleStats.get('precipitationCal').getInfo(); const townsvillePixels = townsvilleCount.get('precipitationCal').getInfo(); console.log('Mount Isa - Pixels:', mountIsaPixels, 'Precip (mm):', mountIsaPrecip ? mountIsaPrecip.toFixed(2) : 'null'); console.log('Townsville - Pixels:', townsvillePixels, 'Precip (mm):', townsvillePrecip ? townsvillePrecip.toFixed(2) : 'null'); if (mountIsaPixels === 0 || townsvillePixels === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (mountIsaPrecip === null || townsvillePrecip === null || isNaN(mountIsaPrecip) || isNaN(townsvillePrecip)) { console.log('Calculation failed - null or NaN result.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Convert to cm (divide by 10) const mountIsaCm = mountIsaPrecip / 10; const townsvilleCm = townsvillePrecip / 10; console.log('Mount Isa rainfall: ' + mountIsaCm.toFixed(2) + ' cm'); console.log('Townsville rainfall: ' + townsvilleCm.toFixed(2) + ' cm'); console.log('Threshold: 65 cm'); // Check if BOTH regions exceeded 65 cm if (mountIsaCm > 65 && townsvilleCm > 65) { console.log('Both regions exceeded 65 cm.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('At least one region did not exceed 65 cm.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
